fact: A pilot of electronic payment terminals for communal revenue collection was launched on 28 March 2023 in four communes (Comè, Glazoué, Porto-Novo, Abomey-Calavi), the ministry saying most communes collect taxes by paper inactive-value receipts.
title: Collecte des recettes communales : Lancement de la phase pilote des Terminaux à paiement électronique à Comè
